goals.objective: Refactor Asgard and the downstream Midgard flake: complete every item in Asgard TODO.md; migrate reusable modules and imports from Midgard into Asgard so Midgard imports only Asgard; allow downstream personal identity and secret-file parameters without embedding PII or secrets; choose and justify idiomatic, community-established module/options/helper patterns (recommend alternatives to parameterized imports if appropriate); adopt flake-parts; move reusable stacks into nix/quadlets alongside modules/overlays, excluding Dockhand and Traefik (Traefik belongs on bare NixOS on Heimdall); parameterize quadlet PII and secrets, only emit secret-dependent attributes when a downstream secret is supplied and the related module is enabled; replace nixvirt with Terranix abstractions for libvirt VMs on Yggdrasil and OCI tenant, extensible to other Terraform resources when needed; keep host/user-specific data downstream, making consumption primarily module selection and configuration. Investigate current repos and TODO first, research primary/community examples to justify the design and consider simplifying flake helpers, agree on consequential design decisions, implement the migration and validate both flakes without importing actual secrets.

tasks.title: Restructure Asgard and establish idiomatic exports
tasks.verificationContract: Move Nix under nix/{modules,home,lib,overlays,quadlets}; adopt flake-parts systems/perSystem and narrowly scoped import-tree; remove duplicate system-loop helpers and explicitly reconcile TODO flake-utils redundancy. Export ordinary dependency-closed NixOS/Home Manager modules and only justified construction helpers. Preserve prior working-tree changes. Real synthetic NixOS/HM configurations evaluate on both declared architectures; format and override checks pass.

tasks.title: Move reusable Midgard logic behind Asgard
tasks.verificationContract: Migrate reusable modules, overlays and upstream imports including Home Manager/WSL/LazyVim, agents, Colmena, disk tooling, Quadlet tooling and ragenix. Midgard's external flake dependency/import wiring is reduced to Asgard, with local host/home configurations retaining hardware, identity, disk layouts, networking, deployment targets and actual secrets. Optional encrypted files/runtime credential paths are typed and guarded; tests cover feature enable/disable and secret present/absent combinations. Midgard host/home outputs evaluate without stale imports or PII copied into Asgard.

tasks.title: Convert retained stacks and implement native Traefik
tasks.verificationContract: Migrate the 24 retained application stack definitions inventoried in docs/migration-plan.md into sanitized nix/quadlets modules. Exclude Dockhand and the Traefik Quadlet; provide native NixOS Traefik support for downstream Heimdall with explicit remote routes. Parameterize identities, domains, endpoints, storage, credentials and device/socket access. Evaluate every catalog entry with synthetic settings and check generated units, dependencies/networks/mounts; default imports start no workloads. Resolve Headscale overlap and OpenHands-versus-agent-policy explicitly.

tasks.title: Replace NixVirt and generate OCI/libvirt infrastructure
tasks.verificationContract: Provide reusable Terranix modules/helpers with host/provider identity and credentials downstream. Translate both OCI roots preserving the nine inventoried resource addresses, state-root separation and existing provider pins/locks. Verify pinned libvirt schema covers existing block storage, device passthrough and QEMU requirements; document any incompatibility instead of silently changing semantics. Generate and validate configuration where feasible; document stable-domain import, state preservation and single-controller handoff. No state read/import/apply/destroy, VM replacement or deployment without explicit authorization.

tasks.title: Implement Pi/Hermes containers, skills and shared MCP
tasks.verificationContract: Implement gated NixOS containers for Pi/Hermes only with explicit non-root identity, workspace/state/credential mounts and narrow host authorization. Distinguish actual agent package from container-entry launcher; verify command/cwd/TTY/environment/exit behavior and isolation, or report a concrete runtime-testing blocker. Integrate agent-skills-nix with one npins-backed source mechanism and downstream-configurable selections, remove hardcoded copied skills, centralize gated MCP definitions using runtime credentials and mcp-cli, and deduplicate Pi plugins without silently discarding intended workflows. Keep actual secrets out of store-generated configs.

tasks.title: Complete language, LSP and editor TODOs
tasks.verificationContract: Retire home/config implementation files by expressing LazyVim/Pi settings in Nix using verified upstream APIs, retaining only intended agent-facing Markdown. Add protobuf LSP/formatter; improve Nix completion/settings with downstream project expressions; put LSP packages/settings in language modules and generate valid pi-lens configuration without duplicate handlers. Correct jk mapping/completion-source behavior and perform executable/config smoke checks plus runtime editor validation where available.

tasks.title: Publish option documentation and verify the full migration
tasks.verificationContract: Generate option JSON and a hosted-site artifact in checks/CI, configure Codeberg Pages publishing, and distinguish build success from actual publishing/runner/token prerequisites. Run format, flake checks, real NixOS/HM integration evaluations, downstream output checks, optional-secret and override tests, Quadlet/Terranix validations and PII/secret-leak review. Update README/AGENTS/TODO to match the agreed contract, account for every original TODO and user requirement, and leave any live-site/runtime/infrastructure prerequisite explicitly blocked rather than mark partial work complete.
